en: What corruption?
The forest spirits are uneasy...

Welcome, my $g brother : sister;.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.$B$BWe are the preservers of the balance, now and forever, as Cenarius has taught us.  Never forget this.
Gaze upon the enemy, $r. See what the might of the Horde reduces even the most powerful of dragons to! All that oppose us shall meet a similar fate!
Be brave, friends. The reptile will thrash wildly. It is an act of desperation. When you are ready, give me the word.
Come speak with me if you are a purveyor of the unusual, or if you have any Darkmoon Faire Cards.
The memory of my beauty makes its loss unbearable!
I should get back before Rema starts to worry...

Well met, $c. I hope you are here to inquire on the Ahn'Qiraj war effort. We are going to need a great deal of assistance.$B$BThe war effort is a united effort between the Alliance and Horde to prepare for the upcoming war against the Silithid and their masters in Ahn'Qiraj. In the Military Ward of Ironforge, we are collecting all manner of goods to create our war materiel from, and these gathering tasks are what we need your help with.$B$BCan I convince you to speak with our commander about pitching in?
The charges are set. Get back before they blow!
What?
My brother and I are on a vital mission, but we are holed up in this farmhouse.  The Deathstalkers need your help.

Certainly, $n.$B$BAdventurers that the Dawn views as honored must submit a combined total of 40 insignias to access superior items. To access items of even greater power, they would be required to submit a total of 150 insignias.$B$BI must admit, the price is high even for those honored amongst the Dawn.
Come on boys, we've got to get this bridge rebuilt.
There is a pile of wrapped gifts here.
I sense danger deep within the grove...
Hmmm, this one looks like something that would be better off as a windchime. Take notes class... This is NOT what you want to summon in the heat of battle.
The Razza just made more fertilizer for Mushgog!
I am 100% confident that I wish to learn in the ways of goblin engineering.

The beasts of these blasted lands exhibit preternatural attributes, heretofore unseen in nature.$B$BWe have theorized that the energy which was released upon the opening of the Dark Portal, infused into their physical being and forced the creatures to evolve into their current forms.$B$BFearsome beasts they are, no doubt, but we also believe that they could prove to be quite useful in our studies.$B$BPerhaps you would be interested in assisting us in the study of these beasts, $n?
%s begins to bubble!

Before I leave this place, I make one final offering to you, Lord Staghelm. Should a time arise in which you must gain entry to this accursed fortress, use the Scepter of the Shifting Sands on the sacred gong. The magic holding the barrier together will dissipate and the horrors of Ahn'Qiraj will be unleashed upon the world once more.
I hope that your interruption is for a good cause. I was in the middle of some important work.
Gnomes can be hard to hit due to their size. However, they have a pinchant for dancing around and thrusting their hips. When they do this, strike at them like so...
%s emerges from the darkness, drawn out by the divination scryer!
Your meddling ends here, $n!  Lord Valthalak shall have his revenge!
You wish to learn the old craft?  You wish to smelt dark iron?$B$BAppease me, $r.  Show me a sacrifice and I will consider it!
Our forces in Alterac Valley need wisdom to achieve victory $c.  You look like the one to lead them.
My weapon be thirsty!
Your base is forfeit, puny mortals!
The Stormpike clan bows to no one, especially the horde!

Because the blade can never be too sharp nor the armor too tough a talented enchanter will always be needed.  Such an enchanter is Taladan, who can show you how to properly weave enchantments to improve your weapons and armor.  Seek him out in the Craftsmen's Terrace.
Dogs of the Cenarion Circle.  Slay them all!
Continue with your story.

That's right, um, $g lad : lass;, all of the war materiel is being transported to Silithus and the last of it should get there within a day. After that, we'll all just have to wait and see who puts forth a $g hero : heroine; to reconstitute the Scepter of the Shifting Sands and ring the gong on the Scarab Dais. Only when that occurs will the war begin to open the gates of Ahn'Qiraj.
Brom Killian teach you how dig up shiny for me.  Him on inner ring of War Quarter.
Foolish $n, you serve me now!
Better luck next time, $n.

Lee's caught some pretty odd things up at Crystal Lake.  He told me a story about this weird mask he fished up some months ago.  If you ask me, I think he just had one too many at the Lion's Pride that night.
Let's get to work, $n!
Perhaps I should tell you why I am here.$B$BDo you know of the Aspect, Deathwing? Or of his progeny, Nefarian and Onyxia?
Your skill is not inconsiderable. Since you appear to have sufficient experience, there is a matter in which I require your aid.
The Waterlord Hydraxis hides off in Azshara, on an island in the Bay of Storms.  What kind of threat can the fool muster from there?
I hear little hearts beating. Yes... beating faster now... soon the beating will stop.
There is more.
Betina, I'd like a replacement Rune of the Dawn please!

If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.
Stay away from Sumi and Tumi. They are....spoken for.
